package.description: A procedural textures authoring and 3D model painting tool based on the Godot game engine

en-US.description: A procedural textures authoring and 3D model painting tool based on the Godot game engine
en-US.longDescription: This is a tool based on Godot Engine that can be used to create textures procedurally and paint 3D models. Its user interface is based on Godot's GraphEdit node: textures and brushes are described as interconnected nodes.
en-US.name: Material Maker
